visible_text: In the figure, O is the centre of the circle ABCD. Points A, B, C and D lie on the circumference. Given that ∠BAO = 28°, ∠BCD = 114° and ∠CDO = 42°, find the measure of ∠ABC.
reasoning: Since OA = OB = OC = OD, triangles OAB, OBC and OCD are isosceles. From ∠BAO = 28°, we get ∠OBA = 28°. From ∠CDO = 42°, we get ∠OCD = 42°. Using ∠BCD = 114°, we find ∠BCO = 114° - 42° = 72°, so ∠OBC = ∠OCB = 72°. Then ∠ABC = ∠ABO + ∠OBC = 28° + 72° = 100°, which corresponds to option C.
